subject: ADR-197: the findings become failures -- a trial keeps the protocol it was run under, and the six page defects three blind trials kept re-finding are closed
body: findings.py opens with the sentence this slice is the rest of: a harness that reports is not a harness that guards. It has guarded the UI categories since ADR-110; what it never covered is the class of defect a blind OPERATOR finds -- arithmetic that disagrees with its own caption, an export that contradicts the screen it was taken from. Three trials running found the same two and FILED both, and the reason is that FIXING THEM WAS BLOCKED: a task claim names a figure and the value the page gave for it, so correcting a page moves the claim and every trace recorded before the fix stops confirming it -- the floors fall and the honest reading of that red is 'you edited the ruler'. A lab keeps the protocol with the data: tools/traces/blindN/tasks/ holds the four task files as of the run and that trial's traces are graded against those, while the live tasks follow the pages; protocol_drift names which claims the two disagree about, and the suite holds that grading against the live task confirms FEWER claims than grading against the protocol -- the evidence the freeze is load-bearing. SIX DEFECTS CLOSED: ten generations of inbreeding compound (12.5% -> 11.8%); the breeding class is no longer the minimum's provenance ('this crop is cited for this crop', on sweet corn); no sowing rate from a dead seed lot; a reagent's name decoded once by the browser that encoded it (KOH 3&ndas, and – on a herbarium label); a column as wide as the widest name (Syringalda); and the .eco cross line follows the page's own verdict instead of hardcoding Aa x Aa vs 3:1. THE ORACLE FOR AN EXPORT IS THE EXPORT -- two checks passed for the wrong reason first time by reading a report box, whose newlines are collapsed. A PAGE IS A SUBJECT NOW: mutate_report's docs directory is symlinks to the real one and a page mutation replaces one link, so six page mutants are each killed by the check that names them. verify_report 194 -> 208, verify_tasks 358 -> 368, mutate_report 118 -> 124. Still filed: the stand sheet's expansion-factor rounding, which moves three figures four tasks claim and needs its own slice.
